scope: Whole up/gate execution and consumer-ownership redesign in a complete FFN: each physical cluster owns a different projection and all L rows; compact direct FP4 decode/native/scale/reduction, then real BF16 redistribution to M03 GeGLU/down.
prior_related: E103 two sequential direct projections + TRF reload failed targeted correctness; this candidate uses one both-cluster producer per row tile with separate physical projection ownership. No claim this fixes the prior failure until measured.
v7b begin_interleaved failed private axis lowering; this candidate has no interleaved Element axis or stream rename.
E123 corrected joint direct passed basic whole FFN but paid raw packed Main assembly; this candidate directly writes separate HBM sources into physical cluster destinations, no raw assembly.
E128 ten six-row fused native/scale/reduce streams passed expanded correctness with materialized E5M2; direct lookup accuracy/resource lifetime must be validated anew.
full_graph: preRMS -> actual3term E5M2 quantizer/broadcast -> cluster0 compact up FP4 and block scales / cluster1 compact gate FP4 and block scales -> one shared xTRF/xscaleVRF load -> ten six-row direct FP4lookup/E5M2native/Mul0xscale/Mul1blockscale/F32Hreduce streams across both clusters -> F32 Row60 DM -> aligned BF16 Row60 -> actual perprojection source-cluster TDMA to Lhalf/LocalRows -> unchanged GeGLU/global scales -> unchanged M03 local down -> F32 cluster sum -> unchanged FFN epilogue

placement.weight: HBM up/gate public L,H compact sources. Physical cluster p owns projection p; slice s owns l=60*s+r. Compact FP4 DM115200B/slice, all60rows retained for10tile consumers. No FP8 weight intermediate or joint packed assembly.
placement.block_scale: Same physical ownership, FP8 DM14400B/slice; six-row F32 scale VRF5760B perstream.
placement.activation: Existing quantized input replicated to both clusters; one E5M2TRF load and32B F32restoration-scaleVRF across10Main streams.
placement.partial: F32 blocks remain in stream through two scales/Hreduce. Only six final rows commit in paired8B stores to Row60F32DM.
placement.output: Physical projectioncluster Row60F32->Row60BF16 in8Bcommits, then sourcecluster selection+L-axis TDMA to cluster=L/7680, slice=4*(L/120%64), element=L%120. Final zero-copy relabel matches existing Dummy2/TileL consumers.

costs.added_risks: Repeated lookup/table setup, direct lookup/native correctness, both HBM inputs and scale views ready before shared consumer, extended xTRF/scaleVRF lifetime, mutable cluster-write dependencies, output routing/packet fragmentation/cross-cluster transfer and changed overlap. Payload reduction is not predicted cycles.
costs.x_trf_scale_load_pairs_after_emitted: verify graph; expected1, no new savings claimed over E128 actual1

first_gate: Build full FFN. Inspect actual ingress descriptor source coverage and destination cluster masks, no FP8 up/gate materialization or packed Main assembly, ten direct fused streams, output source-cluster/Lhalf transfers and8B commit alignment. Repair understood source/API contract errors with preserved attempts instead of arbitrary abandonment. Continue to complete-kernel NPU screen with exact E128 controls when contract passes.
correctness_gate: Basic wholeFFN then actual-quantizer up/gate oracle with distinct scales, physical projection/cluster mapping, sixrow and60row/7680 boundaries, K15/16/63/64/3839, allFP4codes,zero/cancellation/smallvalues. Preserve ((dot*xscale)*blockscale) and existing firstBF16/globalGeGLUscale positions. E128 or E123 validation does not transfer automatically.

decisions.adoption: Not validated. Any positive whole screen triggers bounded contemporary repeats and expanded boundary checks even under5%.
decisions.further_tuning: No row-size sweep. Fix concrete source or transfer issues; resource/overlap evidence determines whether a coherent correction is warranted.
decisions.major_research: Evaluate projection-owned clusters as a complete alternative to Lhalf producer ownership; target decoded weight storage and joint-copy removal, not another six-row local-tile experiment.
